nodes.name: TiO2 Nanosheet Preparation
nodes.procedure: TiO2 nanosized sheet (TNS) was prepared with thickness verified by TEM analysis to be ≈3 nm, showing fine surface morphology with a lattice spacing of 0.35 nm corresponding to the (101) facet of anatase (Figure S1a-c, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: The thickness of the TiO2 nanosized sheet (TNS) was verified by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis to be ≈3 nm (Figure S1a,b, Supporting Information), and it shows fine surface morphology with a lattice spacing of 0.35 nm corresponding to the (101) facet of anatase (Figure S1c, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Co Single-Atom Anchoring
nodes.procedure: A certain density of Co atoms can be individually anchored as monodispersed sites on TNS substrate according to previously reported solvothermal method of single-atom oxide (Figure S2a-c, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: In the anchoring procedure, a certain density of Pt atoms and/or Co atoms can be individually anchored as monodispersed sites on TNS substrate (Figure S2a-c, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Pt Single-Atom Anchoring
nodes.procedure: A certain density of Pt atoms can be individually anchored as monodispersed sites on TNS substrate according to previously reported solvothermal method of single-atom oxide (Figure S2a-c, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: In the anchoring procedure, a certain density of Pt atoms and/or Co atoms can be individually anchored as monodispersed sites on TNS substrate (Figure S2a-c, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Co-Pt Dual Single-Atom Catalyst Preparation
nodes.procedure: Pt and Co single-atoms were decorated on the TNS according to previously reported solvothermal method of single-atom oxide[43]. With random high loading density deposition process, the catalyst forms ≈13.4% oxygen-coordinated Co-O-Pt dimer sites (detailed preparation method described in Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: The preparation method of dual-single-atom site and TiO2 substrate are described in detail in the Supporting Information... Then, the Pt and Co single-atoms were decorated on the TNS according to previously reported solvothermal method of single-atom oxide.
